description:
HAXFINITY — Hack the Infinite

The 24-hour hackathon of XTHRON ’26

12–13 December 2026  
10:30 AM, 12 December – 10:30 AM, 13 December  
Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur, Kerala

Prizes:Exciting prizes — details to be announced  
Team size:2–4 participants  
Participation: Free

Build real solutions, solve meaningful problems, and create something that works.

HAXFINITY is a 24-hour hackathon conducted as part of XTHRON ’26, the annual IT fest of the Department of Computer Science, Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur.

Students from different colleges and backgrounds will identify problems, build software prototypes, and present their work to judges.

The event includes the opening ceremony, a 21-hour project-building window, demonstrations, judging, and awards.

There is no compulsory theme. Teams may choose any problem and build a software solution using any suitable technology.

 Tracks

Open Innovation

Build a product, tool, or prototype that solves a real problem or explores an idea.

AI / ML

Build an application using machine learning, generative AI, NLP, computer vision, data analysis, or another AI-related technology.

Social Good

Build technology that improves people’s lives — for example, in education, healthcare, accessibility, sustainability, financial inclusion, or community welfare.

Detailed judging criteria will be published before the event.


Building window:*11:00 AM, 12 December – 8:00 AM, 13 December (21 hours).

Who Can Participate?

Students from all colleges, streams, and experience levels are welcome.

You can participate as a beginner, developer, designer, or creative problem-solver. Interests in AI, cybersecurity, web, mobile, cloud, or social-impact technology are all welcome.

Team Rules

- Teams must have 2–4 participants.
- Solo entries are not permitted.
- Cross-college and interdisciplinary teams are allowed.
- Each participant may join only one team.
- Every member should actively contribute to the project.

Venue

Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous)
Santhigramam, Eranhimangad  
Nilambur, Malappuram, Kerala — 679329

Check-in and travel details will be shared with registered participants.

 What We Provide

- Workspace, power, and internet access
- Lunch, dinner, breakfast, and midnight snacks
- Mentoring and technical support
- Participation certificates
- Opportunity to demo projects to judges
 Competition Rules

- All project-specific development must happen during the official building window.
- Teams may arrive with an idea, but pre-built projects cannot be submitted.
- Open-source libraries, APIs, datasets, and templates are allowed, subject to their licences.
- Teams must disclose pre-existing components and AI tools used.
- Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools are allowed across all tracks.
- Teams should submit early; late submissions may not be accepted.
- No new features may be added after code freeze.
- A working prototype or meaningful demonstration is expected.
- Teams must be able to explain their technology, process, third-party components, and contributions.
- Projects must not violate copyright, privacy, security, or applicable law.
- All participants must follow the event Code of Conduct.
- Organisers may disqualify entries for plagiarism, misconduct, unsafe content, or rule violations.

## Code of Conduct

All participants are expected to maintain a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming environment. Participants can approach the organising team for assistance or to report a concern.



HAXFINITY — Hack the Infinite
XTHRON ’26
12–13 December 2026
Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur, Kerala
